hero.title: The
hero.description: The final assessment exam at the end of Studienkolleg that certifies your readiness for German university studies and grants nationwide recognition.

overview.title: What is the FSP?
overview.description: The Feststellungsprüfung is your final step to German university admission.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Certifies that your qualifications are equivalent to the German Abitur, enabling direct university admission.

format.title: Format
format.description: Three written exams (3-4 hours each). Taken at the end of your second semester.

recognition.title: Recognition
recognition.description: Your FSP certificate is recognized at all German universities, opening doors nationwide in your field.

structure.title: Exam Structure
structure.description: The FSP consists of written examinations in your course subjects.

items.title: German (DaF)
items.description: Mandatory for all courses, B2/C1 level

items.title: Subject Exam 1
items.description: Core subject based on your course track

courseDetails.title: Subjects by Course
courseDetails.description: Select your course to see which subjects are examined.

grading.title: Grading System
grading.description: Understanding how your FSP is graded.

german.label: German grade:
german.text: Must be at least 4.0; no compensation available.

compensation.label: Compensation:
compensation.text: One subject below 4.0 may be compensated by better grades in others.

betterGrades.label: Better grades = better chances:
betterGrades.text: Your FSP score affects university admission competitiveness.

tips.title: Preparation Tips
tips.description: Maximize your chances of passing with these strategies.

items.title: Attend All Classes
items.description: Consistent attendance is crucial for understanding material

items.title: Structured Study Plan
items.description: Create a schedule covering all subjects systematically

items.title: Form Study Groups
items.description: Collaborate with classmates to discuss and review

items.title: Practice Past Exams
items.description: Familiarize yourself with question formats and timing

items.title: Master Time Management
items.description: Practice completing tasks within time limits

items.title: Use Professor Materials
items.description: Review all provided practice problems and guides

items.title: Take Mock Exams
items.description: Simulate real exam conditions before the test

items.title: Rest and Manage Stress
items.description: Maintain healthy sleep and stress management

after.title: After Passing the FSP
after.description: Congratulations! Your FSP certificate opens the doors to German universities.

universityAccess.title: University Access
universityAccess.description: Apply to any German university in your field of study.

nationwideRecognition.title: Nationwide Recognition
nationwideRecognition.description: Your certificate is valid at all universities across Germany.

competitiveEdge.title: Competitive Edge
competitiveEdge.description: Higher grades improve admission chances for popular programs.

retakeOptions.title: Retake Options
retakeOptions.description: If you fail, you can typically retake the FSP 1-2 times.

cta.title: Ready to Prepare?
cta.description: Start your preparation journey today with our structured German language course.
